profile.summary:

positions.title: Software Engineer | Support Tooling & Apps
positions.description:
🚀 Leading the charge in unifying internal tools with a cohesive look and feel; architected a robust ecosystem for micro frontends and a universal component library for seamless consistency.

🔄 Successfully revamped our Dasher support hub through a webview, and authored a technical blog post on key learnings and challenges: https://doordash.engineering/2023/10/24/revamping-dasher-faq-hub-through-server-driven-content-and-webview/

💡 Developed a CMS tool adhering to SDUI guidelines, enabling our content team to make changes quickly

positions.title: Frontend Engineer | Selling Partner Services - Strategic Initiatives
positions.description:
🚀 Pioneered the Prototype Lab, crafting the blueprint for seamless product and design excellence. Defined engagement models, engineering processes, and success metrics to elevate our game.

💻 Engineered Seller Central's global navigation 2.0—prioritized personalization, notifications, and tasks. Transitioned to production based on user studies with over 80% satisfaction.

projects.title: Patiently - 2016 AT&T Internet of Things (IoT) Hackathon
projects.description:
Front End Engineer

Patiently is an IoT application that helps nurses effectively monitor patients by using motion sensors embedded in hospital beds. Nurses will have access to real-time data analysis and visualizations, along with an intuitive dashboard to check vitals and status. With this type of information handy, nurses are equipped to be where they are needed to support patients.

projects.title: KA-VR - Machine Learning Virtual Assistant
projects.description:
Software Engineer

Virtual assistant that uses natural language processing to listen for voice commands to execute tasks, progressively learning the choice of words, such as context, actions, and verbs.

● Constructed front end user flow with React/Redux to allow for easy integration of additional features
● Built out modal forms of YouTube and Yelp API data that renders based on specific speech input
● Connected relationships in Neo4j for flexibility and fast traversal of data enabling more possibilities for decision making
● Set up local strategy authentication with Passport on the back end with Node.js/Express.js and MySQL
● Designed schemaless database models with MongoDB for storage of dictionary words used by machine learning algorithm
